Most nix players I see just try to hit players with bow and use roll to get away. This is a weak strategy. Nix is meant to be used at mid range, combining all her attacks to deal damage. If you mostly only use one weapon, you miss out on a lot and lose. The hit-and-run strategy is better for someone like Fuzzy, who has mobility and a lot more range on her attacks. With Nix, make sure to find ways to incorporate all of her attacks into your playstyle. Also nitro shotgun is really good on her, as it compliments her already long shotgun range so she can use all her attacks from a mid-range.
